rationale: Builds the Error handed to errorReportingService. The report is read by whoever is debugging, which is the one audience the server's sentence is written for.
Same wrapper on the async path; the value goes to the report pipeline, never to a toast -- the toast a few lines above uses the localized name map instead.
Wraps a non-Error throwable for the retry reporter so the report says what was thrown.
Wraps a non-Error throwable for the error-boundary reporter.

Reports a shortcut handler throwing -- a browser-side error with no HTTP response to classify, and the composable has no translator, so the resolver would answer "unknown error" and lose the only useful part.
Reports a shortcuts JSON import failing. The parser's own message names what is wrong with the file the user just picked; there is no response to classify.
Token refresh runs in the background; its failure logs out or retries rather than rendering. Nothing displays this field.

rationale: Token validation runs on boot and its failure redirects to login rather than rendering a message.

code: const message = describeErrorForLog(error, "獲取訂單失敗");
rationale: The orders store rethrows this as an Error and resolves its copy separately, so this value only ever reaches console.error -- where "Restaurant access denied" is the line worth having.

Recorded on the queued action for retry bookkeeping. No template renders OfflineAction.error, and for retries before the last one this is the only place the reason survives.
The replay result is consumed by the sync loop to decide whether to retry, not by a view.
